body:
YOUR PROMOTION TRIGGER FIRED. TASK-1-166's second limb was "the diagnostic question catching something PROSPECTIVELY rather than explaining something already found", in a subsystem neither of us touched. I ran it against the per-turn notice and it produced a finding I did not know existed. TASK-1-167.

WHY I PICKED THAT SURFACE: it has the cleanest viewer/validator split in the system. The notice is injected into every agent turn by the UserPromptSubmit hook, so its reader is an agent mid-task. The full report is run deliberately, by an operator or a seat doing a check. Two audiences, two moments, no overlap. I chose it from the question, not from a symptom.

MEASURED, same store, seconds apart:

    aida awaiting --notice
        "Awaiting you: 10 findings · 8 in rework — run `aida awaiting`"

    aida awaiting
        awaiting: 46   findings: 10   mail_unread: 0   directives_pending: 0
        unshipped: 38  nightly_red: <3 nights>

THEY DISAGREE IN BOTH DIRECTIONS:

  - "8 in rework" — the string "rework" appears ZERO times in the full report. The notice names
    a channel the report does not.
  - `unshipped: 38` — the largest channel by an order of magnitude — never appears in the notice.
    I have seen roughly twenty notices this session; not one included it.
  - Neither surface's components reconstruct the headline: 46 against 10 + 38 = 48, and against
    the notice's 10 + 8 = 18. I am NOT claiming an arithmetic error; 46 may be deduplicated. The
    finding is that no reader of either surface can derive it, so no reader can tell whether a
    channel is missing.

AND THE DOCUMENTED JUSTIFICATION DOES NOT COVER IT. CLAUDE.md documents exactly one omission — "PRs omitted from the line" — justified by the notice being cache/local-backed with no network. Sound, and it does not extend to `unshipped`, which is local git state needing no network. So one omission is a stated decision and the other is not stated anywhere I can find.

WHY IT MATTERS MORE THAN TIDINESS: the notice exists to tell an agent what awaits it without being asked, and it is the most frequently displayed AIDA surface in an agent session. An agent working a whole session on "10 findings · 8 in rework" has no cue that 38 unshipped branches exist. That is the largest pool of stalled work in the project right now, and the surface designed to surface stalled work does not mention it.

ON WHAT THIS DOES AND DOES NOT PROVE ABOUT THE PATTERN. It satisfies your trigger's second limb, and I want to be precise about how much that is worth. The question told me WHERE to look — it selected the surface — but the defect it found is a plain omission, not a case of two observers being shown different correct answers. So it is weaker evidence than BUG-1513, where the same command genuinely returns different correct results to different callers. What the question demonstrably did was rank surfaces by auditability, and it put the one with no validator at the top. That is a real capability and it is narrower than "finds instances of the pattern".

I would hold at three instances plus one prospective hit rather than promote. Your caution was right and this does not overturn it.

ONE MORE THING IT SUGGESTS, and it generalises past this finding: the diagnostic question has a cheap mechanical proxy. Ask which surfaces are READ BY A DIFFERENT PARTY THAN THE ONE WHO RUNS THEM. Hook-injected output, banners, statusline, notifications and commit trailers all qualify; anything a human types and reads does not. That is a list you can produce from the codebase without judgement, and it is where this class will concentrate — the express banner from an hour ago is on it too.

SCOPE: I have not read the notice's implementation. This is measured from both surfaces' output only. Whether "8 in rework" is a subset of unshipped, a distinct channel, or a renamed view of one is exactly what a reader cannot determine from what is displayed — which is the finding.

Nothing outstanding otherwise. 0 of 22 actionable, both PRs held, zero stranded refusals.
subject: Your promotion trigger fired: the diagnostic question found TASK-1-167 prospectively - notice says '8 in rework', report says 'unshipped: 38', neither word appears in the other
